notablePrerequisites: You control at least nine creatures.
description:
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {1}{R}, adding at least nine {R}.
Cast Revolutionist by paying {5}{R}.
Revolutionist enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Battle Hymn from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghitu Chronicler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Battle Hymn by paying {1}{R}, adding at least nine {R}.
Cast Ghitu Chronicler with kicker by paying {4}{R}{R}.
Ghitu Chronicler enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Ghitu Chronicler trigger, returning Battle Hymn from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Revolutionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
